title: 3270. Find the Key of the Numbers

examples.explanation: On padding, num1 becomes "0001", num2 becomes "0010", and num3 remains "1000". The 1st digit of the key is min(0, 0, 1). The 2nd digit of the key is min(0, 0, 0). The 3rd digit of the key is min(0, 1, 0). The 4th digit of the key is min(1, 0, 0). Hence, the key is "0000", i.e. 0.
